node.statement: Lemma 3.1 (Symmetric subspace in double Schur basis): (Schur^{tensor 2}) Pi_sym^{n,D} (Schur^{tensor 2})^dag = sum_{lambda: ell(lambda)<=r} |lambda,lambda><lambda,lambda|_{YY'} tensor |EPR_lambda><EPR_lambda|_{PP'} tensor I_{QQ'}, where D = dr, the sum is over partitions lambda of n with at most r parts, and |EPR_lambda> = (1/sqrt(dim(lambda))) sum_S |S>|S> is the Specht EPR state. Proof: Apply the double Schur transform to the S_n-average formula for Pi_sym. Use grand orthogonality relations and the factorization P_{AB}(pi) = P_A(pi) tensor P_B(pi) (Proposition 2.6). The constraint ell(lambda) <= r arises because V_lambda^r = 0 when lambda has more than r parts.
